title: Listening through the ground
alt: A science bay opens like a treasure chest to reveal a compact gold seismic package. A ground cutaway beneath the scene carries a drawn wave, contrasting ground vibration with the silent sky.
context: Eagle carried a seismic experiment for deployment on the surface. The cutaway wave illustrates ground motion and is not recorded lunar data.
interpretation: Original story illustration. Viewpoint, lighting, pose, geometry and apparent distances are interpretive. Scientific arrows, waves, cutaways and displays explain principles; they are not recorded telemetry, a literal instrument diagram or a historical photograph.

sources.label: NASA · The seismometer detects the crew’s footsteps
